entities.name: Walter Hungerford, 1st Baron Hungerford

entities.summary: Walter Hungerford, 1st Baron Hungerford was an English knight and landowner, from 1400 to 1414 a Member of the House of Commons, of which he became Speaker, then was an Admiral and peer.
